Every model call is followed by a deterministic gate; every step
is cached and resumable; no model runs while the player plays.
characters: id, name, look, voice, [first, last] chapter
chapters: summary, goal, beats {plain, original, source_ids}
lines: character, chapter, plain, original, source_ids
Invariants checked by validate, not by the model:
∀ source_id: exists in the book ∧ lies in the element's chapter
∀ chapter: |beats| ≥ 3; ∀ line: chapter within its speaker's range
∀ plain: |words| ≤ 14; ids unique; chapter order = book order
The adapted game shows these texts and nothing else in a character's voice.
slot = ⟨id, role, kind, required, count, where {files, code}, format⟩
role ∈ {player, npc, enemy, pickup, terrain, decoration, backdrop, portrait, ui, sound,
music, font, parameter}; kind ∈ {sheet, tileset, image, model, material, colour, audio, font,
grounded iff every named file exists ∧ claimed size ∈ measured sizes ∧ sheet divisible by its
frame ∧ animation rows and frames fit ∧ metadata file and code refs exist ∧ a colour value is
A fill is ⟨slot, subject⟩ → path, size, prompt; replaces[upstream] = path. The adapter
rewires slots to fills, never draws, resizes or recolours (contract §12).
goto(id) teleport next to a character or item
talk() collect() interact with what is in front
state() chapter, beats seen, items collected, lines heard
